Hi Evan — thanks for flagging this and for the usage file. Looping in Marcus (Finance) and Neha (Sales Ops) so we can align on the accounting flow.

Options we typically use:
- Issue a credit memo that posts against your AR (standard, preserves invoice history)
- Apply an invoice offset if the invoice is still open in the AR system (faster but depends on timing)
- One-time bill adjustment (rare, for very small corrections)

Can you confirm the exact credit amount you expect us to apply (the usage file shows $28,742 but confirm if you want the full $30,000 allowance applied). Also please confirm the PO number (if required by your AP) and whether you need the credit memo addressed to a legal entity other than PilotCo.

I attached a draft credit memo template to accelerate internal approvals. Marcus — any accounting constraints we should surface to the customer? Neha — if we proceed, can you update HS-23456 with the approval and upload the signed cover note?

Mina

Mina / Evan — thanks. I pulled invoice #PC-INV-6273 and the usage file. Quick accounting guidance so finance and the customer are aligned: 

1) Preferred treatment: issue a credit memo that posts to AR and reduces the outstanding invoice balance. This creates a clear audit trail.
2) GLA mapping: credit memos should hit contra-revenue (GLA: 4200-CR) and reduce Accounts Receivable (GLA: 1100-AR). If the credit is for a promotional allowance rather than price correction, we recommend using an allowance account (GLA: 5405-ALLOW) to keep promo spend visible.
3) Tax treatment: credit memos tied to product usage should mirror the original tax calculation; provide the original tax amount so we can reverse properly.
4) Required fields for us to generate the memo: original invoice number, desired credit amount, PO number (if AP requires matching), billing contact and billing address, and a signed approval from the sales manager or authorized rep.
5) Timing: once we receive the signed approval and PO (if needed), we can issue the credit memo in 3–7 business days. Posting to your receivables may show up on your AR aging in the next EOD batch.

Evan — please provide: final credit amount (confirm $30,000 vs $28,742), PO (if required), and whether PilotCo wants the memo dated May 31 or the date of issuance (we can accommodate either for month-end needs).

I attached a GL mapping template to complete for our accounting import.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Director, Finance | Redwood Inference

Attachments: GL_mapping_template.xlsx (XLSX)
